About

A venture-building institution that creates, scales and strengthens businesses.

Entrepreneurial in ambition. Disciplined in execution. Long-term in outlook.

01 What Accelity Partners is

The capability to build enduring businesses.

Accelity Partners Pvt Ltd is a venture-building and holding company that creates, incubates, acquires and scales businesses across sectors. We build our own ventures and work with selected businesses where an ownership or partnership model can create long-term value.

Each venture has its own purpose and leadership, strengthened by relevant capabilities within the wider group.

02 Mission and vision
Our mission
To build and scale enduring businesses by combining entrepreneurship, technology, capital, operating discipline and shared capabilities across sectors.
Our vision
To build a multi-generational institution that repeatedly creates and scales businesses capable of generating economic, societal and national value.

The mission describes our contribution. The vision describes the institution we aim to become.

03 Defining our brand

Four principles that hold across every venture.

Purposeful entrepreneurship
Identify meaningful opportunities and build business models around them.
Shared capability
Strengthen technology, talent, governance and execution that can benefit the group.
Accountable autonomy
Give venture leaders room to execute, with clear priorities and responsibility.
Enduring value
Build businesses that become stronger over time, not dependent on continual intervention.
04 How we talk about progress

Conviction in the vision, separate from evidence of performance.

We describe the institution we are building without guaranteeing results. Where we publish an outcome, we publish its context and its limits.

We do sound like

  • We build, own and scale businesses across sectors.
  • We expand where shared capabilities create an advantage.
  • Each venture has its own leadership and accountability.
  • We connect entrepreneurship with disciplined execution.
  • Our ambition is to build enduring institutions.

We do not sound like

  • We are a consultancy that can fix any business.
  • Every category is an opportunity we must enter now.
  • One formula. Every company. Guaranteed success.
  • We guarantee rapid, exponential growth.
  • Our planned portfolio already proves our success.
